The '''waterfall cave''' was a cavern located on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[Qyzen Fess]] went to search for [[Nalen Raloch]] in order to help [[Yuon Par]] and her [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi padawan]] in the cave, but was captured by an overwhelming amount of enemies. After a short while, the Padawan was sent to search for him. After rescuing Fess, the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] traveled along with the Padawan to the [[Fount of Rajivari]].<ref name="TOR" />
